title: ascalea lanceolata
intro: Ascalea lanceolata, commonly known as Sweet Goldenrod, is a flowering plant native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and aiding in respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Sweet Goldenrod include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which make it useful in treating wounds, infections, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Sweet Goldenrod include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
